svg.title: Work across linked machines
svg.desc: Machine A and the T3 app card of machine B sit inside the same Kitshn circle, which defines who has access. Machine B shares its card into the circle. The parent thread on A delegates through that card to B, within the grant and the thread's limits. B works with its own checkout and tools, and completion returns to the parent thread.

g.title: Machine B's T3 app card, shared into the circle
